registryEvidence.basis: Official Sudan Judiciary material identifies the Land Registrations administration as the cadastral/land-registration custodian, with the General Registrar and branch offices in all states. It describes land settlement, opening registers, cadastral sketches/maps, and registration offices. This is a national official custodian and procedure source; it does not prove a Rabak-specific public parcel endpoint.
registryEvidence.localityEvidence: No first-party Rabak or White Nile local registry office page, map layer, or parcel response was found. Rabak locality coverage is therefore unverified.

officialSources.observation: Sudan Judiciary page states the Land Registrations administration has a central General Registrar and branch offices in all states; explains settlement, register opening, cadastral sketches/maps, and registration offices. No public parcel service is exposed.

Official Aqari platform describes a national Judiciary-linked electronic land/real-estate registration service and services for record review, certificates, and subdivision. Public landing page exposes no anonymous map, parcel geometry, schema, or safe parcel-ID query.

Official National Information Center project page describes Sudan Spatial Portal as a WMS/WFS-capable national spatial viewer and links to https://www.geoportal.gov.sd/. The linked host could not be resolved in the bounded request.

routes.outcome: Official Judiciary land-registration custodian and procedures found; no Rabak parcel geometry or public query endpoint.
Official Aqari registration platform found; landing page contains service descriptions only and no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response.
Official NIC page found; describes national WMS/WFS spatial portal and links to geoportal.gov.sd.
TLS-verified bounded GET attempted; DNS resolution timed out after 20 seconds. No retry with altered TLS, credentials, or bypass was attempted.
Public HTML inspection via official page found no map configuration, WMS/WFS URL, parcel schema, CRS, or safe anonymous parcel query.

remainingUncertainty: The official sources establish Sudan’s land-registration custodian and a claimed national spatial portal, but current Rabak coverage, public anonymous access, schema, CRS, stable native identity, geometry licensing, update cadence, and adapter behavior remain unverified. A DNS timeout or no exact-point response would not establish citywide absence.
